g.text: ECOSTEP QCU — COMPLETE HARDWARE CIRCUIT & WIRING BLUEPRINT (IPT2 + AR101)
1. Recycled Kinetic Tile (16x PZT + Trigger Disc) ➔ 2. Breadboard (Rectifier, 5.1V Zener, Storage, Dividers) ➔ 3. "I ❤️ QCU!" Sign ➔ 4. ESP32-WROOM-32 ➔ 5. CustomTkinter + PostgreSQL
• 16x Neoprene plunger studs press center of
PZT discs by max 2.0mm before hitting M8 bolts.
• Ceramic discs can NEVER be crushed!
to ESP32 3V3 (D34 has no internal pull-up).
Never touch raw AC1/AC2 or raw VH directly
to ESP32 pins! Always pass through the
2. BREADBOARD: CONDITIONING, STORAGE BANK, VOLTAGE DIVIDERS & 3. "I ❤️ QCU!" SIGN
+ VH RAW RECTIFIED RAIL (Clamped at 5.1V by Zener 1N4733A)
− COMMON GROUND RAIL (GND) — Connects Tile Brass, Rectifier, Caps, Sign (-), & ESP32 GND
D5 (1N5819) Check Valve + Path A/B Switch
VH (+) ➔ [D5 Stripe] ➔ Path A (Direct) / Path B (5V Reg)
Blocks energy from leaking back into piezo bridge
BREADBOARD ISOLATION CHANNEL • POWER BUS TO LOAD STAGE
3. ON-DEMAND OUTPUT LOAD: "I ❤️ QCU!" RECYCLED 18-LED EVACUATION SIGN (IPT2 TABLE 3 & FIGURE 5)
Discharge & Brightness Selector (From VSC Storage / 5V Regulated Rail via 500mA Polyfuse)
RECYCLED HOLIDAY MICRO-LED SIGN BOARD — 18 LEDs TOTAL (2.8V–5V DC BUS)
"Q C U" (9 Green / White LEDs — 3 per Letter)
Anodes (+) ➔ From SW2 Resistor Output (1.5kΩ / 10kΩ) | Cathodes (−) ➔ Return to Breadboard Common GND (−) Rail
• Full Mode (1.5 kΩ): ~25 mA ➔ P = 5V × 25mA = 125 mW (~9.4s pure PZT / ~3.5+ min supercap) • Dim Mode (10 kΩ): ~3.5 mA ➔ 17.5 mW (3–30+ min)
2. Plug ESP32 USB-C into laptop (0% tile drain).
